```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
```

```{python}
load_dotenv()

data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
BUFFER_MILES = 50
BUFFER_METERS = BUFFER_MILES * 1609.344

geojson_path = data_dir / "county_fips_codes" / "geojson_counties_fips.json"

OVERLAP_TABLE = f"transformed.county_buffer_overlap_{BUFFER_MILES}mi"
OUTPUT_TABLE = f"transformed.naics_518_nearby_estabs_{BUFFER_MILES}mi"

SQM_PER_SQMI = 2_589_988.110336
```

```{python}
counties_df = pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT
        county_id,
        land_area_sqmi,
        water_area_sqmi
    FROM us_counties
""", engine)

dc_df = pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT
        county_id,
        year,
        estabs
    FROM naics_518_establishments
""", engine)
```

```{python}
counties_geo = gpd.read_file(geojson_path)

# Fix for mismatch of old county code 
counties_geo["id"] = counties_geo["id"].replace({"46113": "46102"})

counties_geo = counties_geo[["id", "geometry"]].copy()
counties_geo = counties_geo.rename(columns = {"id": "county_id"})
```

```{python}
counties_final = counties_df.merge(counties_geo, on = "county_id", how = "left")
```

```{python}
counties_final = gpd.GeoDataFrame(counties_final, geometry="geometry", crs="EPSG:4326")

counties_final = counties_final.to_crs(5070) 

counties_final["geometry"] = counties_final.geometry.make_valid()
```

```{python}
counties_final["geom_area_sqmi"] = counties_final.geometry.area / SQM_PER_SQMI

counties_final["total_area_sqmi"] = (
    counties_final["land_area_sqmi"] +
    counties_final["water_area_sqmi"]
)

counties_final["land_share"] = (
    counties_final["land_area_sqmi"] / counties_final["total_area_sqmi"]
)
```

```{python}
buffers = counties_final[["county_id", "geometry"]].copy()
buffers["geometry"] = buffers.geometry.buffer(BUFFER_METERS) 
buffers = buffers.rename(columns={"county_id": "target_county_id"})
```
